plans.executive_summary: Incident inc-001 details a critical compromise of ssh-srv involving external reconnaissance (port scanning), brute-force credential access, privilege escalation via sudo, and subsequent data exfiltration to an external IP address (198.51.100.200) originating from attacker IP 203.0.113.213.

immediate_actions.action: Block attacker IP address at the perimeter firewall
Isolate the compromised server from the network for forensic analysis
Revoke active sessions and reset credentials for the compromised deploy user

investigation_steps: Review authentication logs on ssh-srv around 2026-10-16T20:47:13Z for further details on the brute-force attack and successful login.
Examine sudo logs to verify actions taken by the deploy user after escalating privileges.
Inspect network flow logs and outbound connections to determine the full scope of data exfiltrated to 198.51.100.200.
Perform a full forensic disk and memory analysis on ssh-srv to identify any backdoors, webshells, or persistence mechanisms.
prevention: Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) for all SSH and remote service logins.
Enforce strict password complexity and account lockout policies to mitigate brute-force and password spraying attacks.
Review and restrict sudo access rights, ensuring privileged escalation actions are strictly audited and limited to administrative hours.
Deploy network intrusion detection and data loss prevention (DLP) tools to monitor and block unauthorized outbound data transfers.
